Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

Beyond Bloom ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or engage our services. Please read this carefully.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following personal information:

  • Name, email address, telephone number, and nationality when you submit an enquiry or contact form.
  • Property preferences, budget range, and investment objectives shared during consultations.
  • Browser and device data collected automatically via cookies and analytics tools (IP address, session data, referral source).

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used exclusively to:

  • Respond to your property enquiries and arrange viewings.
  • Provide personalised property recommendations and investment advice.
  • Send relevant property updates, market reports, and new listings you have opted in to receive.
  • Comply with our obligations under UAE law, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations and RERA requirements.
  • Improve our website and services through anonymised analytics data.

3. Confidentiality

All client information is treated with the highest degree of confidentiality. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Your information is shared only with: (a) members of the Beyond Bloom advisory team directly handling your enquiry; (b) regulated legal and financial professionals where required to complete a transaction; (c) regulatory bodies as required by UAE law.

4. Data Storage & Security

Your data is stored securely on servers located within the UAE and European Economic Area. We implement technical and organisational measures appropriate to the sensitivity of the data. All staff are bound by strict confidentiality obligations.

5. Cookies

Our website uses essential cookies to ensure proper functionality. We may also use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand site usage. You may disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect website functionality.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to: access the personal data we hold about you; request correction or deletion of your data; withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time; and lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@beyondbloomdubai.com.

7. Retention

We retain personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described, and thereafter as required by UAE regulatory and legal obligations (typically 5–7 years for transaction records).

8. Contact

For any privacy-related questions, please contact:
